facts.fact: The cistern housing on the east rampart is man-high, with a door Devan steps out of. The pala grove and meeting stone stand on the second spur, higher than the rampart (consistent with F073). Neela judged the lee from the wall-walk, where the housing flank and the low parapet shoulder looked solid, but from the grove Ammu looks down onto the spot and nothing hides it. This replaces the earlier chest-high-roof, downslope-grove version.
